statement: Build a one-page website for Brew Lab, a cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, that shows the menu, opening hours and location, lets visitors pre-order for pickup, and features a large photo gallery of the cafe and a detailed story section for each of its three coffee farms, at low cost.
audience: Local customers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, who want to check the menu, hours and location and pre-order coffee for pickup, plus coffee lovers interested in where the beans come from. Most will be on mobile.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a single file, no build step; CDN libraries allowed
Low cost: no paid services or paid libraries required for the site to work
Mobile-first, readable and usable on a phone screen
Gallery images load lazily so the large gallery does not slow the page
Any content fact not supplied by the Requester is shown as a clearly marked placeholder, never invented
rules: One page only, with in-page navigation to each section
Never invent facts: prices, phone numbers, addresses, hours, farm names or farm details stay as marked placeholders until supplied
Keep both the large photo gallery and the detailed farm stories; neither may be cut to save space
Do not add payment collection or any paid service unless the Requester asks for it
done_when: The single HTML file contains separate, linked sections for Menu, Hours, Location, Pre-order, Gallery and Farm stories
The Menu section lists items in categories, with each price shown or marked as a placeholder
The Hours section lists opening times for every day of the week, or marked placeholders
The Location section shows the cafe name, an Indiranagar, Bengaluru address (or marked placeholder) and an embedded or linked map
The Pre-order section has a form where a visitor picks menu items and quantities, enters name, phone number and pickup time, and sees an order summary with a total before submitting
The Gallery section holds at least 12 image slots with alt text, lazy loading, and a way to view each image larger

The Farm stories section has three separate entries, one per coffee farm, each with a heading, a multi-paragraph story area, and image slots, with farm names and facts as marked placeholders where unknown
The page is responsive: it has a viewport meta tag and CSS rules that adapt the layout for narrow screens
The file needs no build step and loads any external library only from a CDN
Every unsupplied fact is visibly marked as a placeholder in the page
open_inputs: Full menu: items, categories and prices
Exact street address and map link or coordinates
Cafe phone number and, if any, WhatsApp or email for receiving pre-orders
How pre-orders reach the cafe and whether payment happens online or at pickup
Pickup time rules, such as minimum lead time and slot length
Names, locations and stories of the three coffee farms, plus farm photos
Logo, brand colours and any tagline
